display.text:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Layout
      # Checks if empty lines exist around the bodies of methods.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   def foo
      #     # ...
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #
      #   def bar
      #
      #     # ...
      #
      #   end
      class EmptyLinesAroundMethodBody < Base
        include EmptyLinesAroundBody
        extend AutoCorrector

        KIND = 'method'

        def on_def(node)
          body = node.body
          current_style = style
          return if body.nil? && current_style != :no_empty_lines
          return if node.single_line?

          source = processed_source
          source_lines = source.lines
          buffer = source.buffer
          method_range = node.source_range
          keyword_loc = node.loc.keyword
          name_loc = node.loc.name
          end_loc = node.loc.end
          keyword_line = keyword_loc.line
          name_line = name_loc.line
          end_line = end_loc.line
          first_line = method_range.first_line
          last_line = method_range.last_line
          last_line = [last_line, end_line, end_loc.last_line].max
          kind = self.class::KIND
          extra_template = MSG_EXTRA

          if node.defs_type?
            receiver = node.receiver
            receiver_range = receiver.source_range
            receiver_line = receiver_range.line
            last_line = [last_line, end_line, receiver_line, name_line].max
          else
            last_line = [last_line, end_line, keyword_line, name_line].max
          end

          arguments = node.arguments
          args_range = arguments.source_range
          if args_range
            last_line = [last_line, args_range.line].max
          else
            last_line = [last_line, first_line].max
          end

          if body
            body_range = body.source_range
            last_line = [last_line, body_range.last_line].max
          end

          beginning_index = first_line
          beginning_text = source_lines[beginning_index]
          beginning_empty = true
          beginning_limit = beginning_text.length
          if beginning_limit.zero?
            beginning_empty = !comment_line?(beginning_text)
          else
            beginning_char = 0
            while beginning_char < beginning_limit && beginning_empty
              current_char = beginning_text[beginning_char]
              beginning_empty = false if current_char
              beginning_char += 1
            end
          end

          if beginning_empty
            beginning_desc = 'beginning'
            beginning_message = format(extra_template, kind: kind, location: beginning_desc)
            beginning_line_number = beginning_index + 1
            beginning_column = 0
            beginning_length = 1
            beginning_line_range = buffer.line_range(beginning_line_number)
            beginning_line_begin_pos = beginning_line_range.begin_pos
            beginning_begin_pos = beginning_line_begin_pos + beginning_column
            beginning_end_pos = beginning_begin_pos + beginning_length
            beginning_offense_range = Parser::Source::Range.new(
              buffer, beginning_begin_pos, beginning_end_pos
            )
            add_offense(beginning_offense_range, message: beginning_message) do |corrector|
              EmptyLineCorrector.correct(corrector, [current_style, beginning_offense_range])
            end
          end

          ending_index = last_line - 2
          ending_text = source_lines[ending_index]
          ending_empty = true
          ending_limit = ending_text.length
          if ending_limit.zero?
            ending_empty = !comment_line?(ending_text)
          else
            ending_char = 0
            while ending_char < ending_limit && ending_empty
              current_char = ending_text[ending_char]
              ending_empty = false if current_char
              ending_char += 1
            end
          end

          if ending_empty
            ending_desc = 'end'
            ending_message = format(extra_template, kind: kind, location: ending_desc)
            ending_line_number = ending_index + 1
            ending_column = 0
            ending_length = 1
            ending_line_range = buffer.line_range(ending_line_number)
            ending_line_begin_pos = ending_line_range.begin_pos
            ending_begin_pos = ending_line_begin_pos + ending_column
            ending_end_pos = ending_begin_pos + ending_length
            ending_offense_range = Parser::Source::Range.new(
              buffer, ending_begin_pos, ending_end_pos
            )
            add_offense(ending_offense_range, message: ending_message) do |corrector|
              EmptyLineCorrector.correct(corrector, [current_style, ending_offense_range])
            end
          end
        end
        alias on_defs on_def

        private

        def style
          :no_empty_lines
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

display.text:
# frozen_string_literal: true

RSpec.describe RuboCop::Cop::Layout::EmptyLinesAroundMethodBody, :config do
  let(:beginning_offense_annotation) { '^{} Extra empty line detected at method body beginning.' }
  let(:end_offense_annotation) { '^{} Extra empty line detected at method body end.' }

  it 'registers an offense for method body starting with a blank' do
    expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
      def some_method

      #{beginning_offense_annotation}
        do_something
      end
    RUBY

    expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
      def some_method
        do_something
      end
    RUBY
  end

  # The cop only registers an offense if the extra line is completely empty. If
  # there is trailing whitespace, then that must be dealt with first. Having
  # two cops registering offense for the line with only spaces would cause
  # havoc in autocorrection.
  it 'accepts method body starting with a line with spaces' do
    expect_no_offenses(['def some_method', '  ', '  do_something', 'end'].join("\n"))
  end

  it 'registers an offense for class method body starting with a blank' do
    expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
      def Test.some_method

      #{beginning_offense_annotation}
        do_something
      end
    RUBY

    expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
      def Test.some_method
        do_something
      end
    RUBY
  end

  it 'registers an offense for method body ending with a blank' do
    expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
      def some_method
        do_something

      #{end_offense_annotation}
      end
    RUBY
  end

  it 'registers an offense for class method body ending with a blank' do
    expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
      def Test.some_method
        do_something

      #{end_offense_annotation}
      end
    RUBY
  end

  it 'is not fooled by single line methods' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      def some_method; do_something; end

      something_else
    RUBY
  end

  it 'registers an offense for methods with empty lines and arguments spanning multiple lines' do
    expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
      def some_method(
        arg
      )

      #{beginning_offense_annotation}
        do_something
      end
    RUBY

    expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
      def some_method(
        arg
      )
        do_something
      end
    RUBY
  end

  it 'registers an offense for methods with empty lines, empty arguments spanning multiple lines' do
    expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
      def some_method(

      )

      #{beginning_offense_annotation}
        do_something
      end
    RUBY

    expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
      def some_method(

      )
        do_something
      end
    RUBY
  end
end

part.text:
Fixed `Layout/EmptyLinesAroundMethodBody` for methods whose argument list spans multiple lines.

The cop now determines the beginning-of-body check from the signature’s final line, including the closing parenthesis, instead of from the method declaration’s first line. It also uses `args_range.last_line` for multiline argument ranges.
